item.description: More than 100,000 Guyanese children will now grow up with their baseline health data captured and permanently recorded under the government’s expanding digital healthcare system, President Dr Mohamed Irfaan Ali announced on Saturday. item.title: Press Release: Government of Guyana Statement on peace and stability in the Middle East
item.description: The Government of Guyana reiterates the need for the sustained pursuit of lasting peace and stability for the Middle East.
